en: Giving advice or suggestions; or an official warning or notice.
ex: She serves on the company's advisory board.
她擔任公司顧問委員會的成員。

en: A small line in the skin, especially on the face or hands; or a small fold in cloth.
ex: She has deep wrinkles around her eyes.
她的眼角有深深的皺紋。

en: A large farm in a hot country where crops such as tea, rubber or sugar are grown.
ex: Workers pick tea leaves on the plantation.
工人在茶園裡採茶葉。

en: The ability to continue doing something difficult for a long time; or to bear pain or hardship.
ex: Marathon running requires great endurance.
馬拉松需要極大的耐力。

en: A small amount of something; something of little value; or a British dessert of cake, fruit and cream.
ex: They argued over a mere trifle.
他們為了一件小事吵了起來。

en: Great sadness or trouble.
ex: The company is facing financial woes.
這家公司正面臨財務困境。

en: The row of bones down your back; or the main strength or support of something.
ex: Small businesses are the backbone of the economy.
小企業是經濟的骨幹。

en: Before something happens or before a particular time.
ex: Please let me know beforehand if you can't come.
如果你不能來，請事先告訴我。

en: To hit someone or something hard and repeatedly; or a mixture of flour, eggs and milk used for cooking; or a baseball player who hits the ball.
ex: The waves battered the shore all night.
海浪整夜猛擊著海岸。

en: To exist in large numbers or amounts.
ex: Rumors abound about the company's future.
關於公司前途的謠言四起。

en: The ability to think, learn and understand; or a very intelligent person.
ex: Einstein was a man of extraordinary intellect.
愛因斯坦是個智力非凡的人。

en: A climbing plant that produces grapes; or any plant with a long stem that grows along the ground or up a support.
ex: Vines covered the walls of the old house.
藤蔓爬滿了那棟舊房子的牆壁。

en: To practice a play, concert or speech before performing it for the public; or to repeat something several times.
ex: The actors rehearsed the scene several times.
演員們把這一幕排練了好幾次。

en: A comparison between two things that shows how they are similar.
ex: He drew an analogy between the heart and a pump.
他把心臟比作幫浦。

en: Something impressive or unusual to look at; or (plural) glasses.
ex: The fireworks display was a magnificent spectacle.
煙火表演是個壯觀的景象。

en: A member of an organized group of violent criminals.
ex: The film is about a gangster in 1930s Chicago.
這部電影講的是1930年代芝加哥的一個黑幫分子。

en: Consisting of many different kinds of things that are not related to each other.
ex: The box contained miscellaneous tools and bits of wire.
盒子裡裝著各種工具和幾段電線。

en: To cut grass with a machine or a long blade.
ex: He mows the lawn every Saturday morning.
他每個星期六早上割草。

en: A line of people or vehicles moving slowly in an organized way, especially at a ceremony.
ex: A procession of mourners followed the coffin.
一列送葬者跟在棺材後面。

en: To think quietly and deeply about something; or to practice calming the mind through quiet thought.
ex: She meditates for twenty minutes every morning.
她每天早上冥想二十分鐘。

en: To be greater in number than another group.
ex: Women now outnumber men in the medical profession.
現在醫界女性人數超過男性。

en: A thick yellow-black liquid found under the ground, used to make fuel such as gasoline.
ex: Petroleum is refined into gasoline and diesel fuel.
石油被提煉成汽油和柴油。

en: To appear repeatedly as a ghost in a place; or to be constantly in someone's mind; or a place a person often visits.
ex: The memory of the accident still haunts him.
那場事故的回憶仍縈繞在他心頭。

en: Believing that people care only about themselves and are not sincere.
ex: He is cynical about politicians and their promises.
他對政客及其承諾持懷疑態度。

en: To move away from the right place or path; or an animal that has lost its home.
ex: A stray dog followed me home.
一隻流浪狗跟著我回家。

en: Agreement or being in line with a rule, law or standard.
ex: The work was done in accordance with the plans.
工作是按照計畫進行的。

en: Without any limits or conditions.
ex: A mother's love for her child is unconditional.
母親對孩子的愛是無條件的。

en: The practice of thinking deeply or focusing your mind in silence, often for relaxation or religious reasons.
ex: Meditation helps her relax after a stressful day.
冥想幫助她在壓力大的一天後放鬆。

en: A small, brown bird that is very common in towns and cities.
ex: A sparrow landed on the window ledge.
一隻麻雀停在窗台上。

en: A person who takes part in sports, especially one who behaves fairly and honorably.
ex: He is a keen sportsman who plays tennis and golf.
他是個熱愛運動的人，打網球也打高爾夫。

en: To make a deep sound because of pain, unhappiness or effort; or to complain in an unhappy way.
ex: The audience groaned when they heard the bad news.
觀眾聽到壞消息時發出呻吟。

en: The number 1,000,000,000,000; or an extremely large number or amount.
ex: The national debt has reached trillions of dollars.
國債已達數兆美元。

en: To improve something by making small changes; or to remove unwanted substances from something.
ex: Engineers continue to refine the design.
工程師們仍在不斷改進這個設計。

en: Not certain or not able to be trusted; probably not honest.
ex: The company has a dubious reputation for honesty.
這家公司的誠信名聲可疑。

en: Arriving or doing something at the exact time arranged.
ex: Please be punctual; the meeting starts at nine sharp.
請準時；會議九點整開始。

en: To refuse to buy, use or take part in something as a form of protest.
ex: Customers boycotted the company after the scandal.
醜聞爆發後，顧客抵制了這家公司。

en: Agreed on by everyone in a group, with no one disagreeing.
ex: The jury reached a unanimous verdict.
陪審團達成了一致的裁決。

en: So amazing that it seems to have been caused by magic or a power beyond nature.
ex: He made a miraculous recovery after the accident.
事故後他奇蹟般地康復了。

en: Sad because you are alone; or (of a place) quiet and without people.
ex: He felt lonesome living alone in the city.
他獨自住在城裡覺得很寂寞。

en: A small, round, red vegetable with a hot taste, eaten raw in salads.
ex: She added some radishes to the salad.
她在沙拉裡加了一些小蘿蔔。
